newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange closes barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange closes barely changed.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange closed barely changed on Monday after trading dominated by shares in Ghana Commercial Bank (GCB).
The GSE All-Share Index fell 0.08 points to 384.31 points from Friday's 384.39.
GCB, which closed unchanged at 750 cedis, accounted for 424,300 of the 434,900 shares that changed hands.
A total of 1,725,810 shares, 1,042,900 of them GCB shares, were offered against bids of 565,300. Market capitalisation fell to 3,256.84 billion cedis from 3,256.96 billion cedis on Friday.

Fan Milk Ltd (+4 cedis at 390 cedis) and Pioneer Aluminium Factory (+2 cedis at 154 cedis) rose. Kumasi Brewery Ltd (-3 cedis at 650 cedis) and Social Security Bank (-3 cedis at 1,030 cedis) fell in value. ($1=1,700 cedis)
